data.one_liner: A Sliver Flutter widget that expands or collapses another child Sliver widget.
data.what_it_does: Sliver Expandable allows developers to add expand and collapse functionality to any Sliver in Flutter. It supports headers and animated transitions when toggling the expanded state.
use_when: You need collapsible sections inside a CustomScrollView
You want to build expandable lists using slivers
avoid_when: You are not using CustomScrollView or slivers in your layout
You only need standard non-sliver expansion panels
strengths: Works natively with Flutter slivers and CustomScrollView
Includes support for animated expansion and headers
